# The checks

The same 29 checks as the program (part 1), in the same order, with the same ids, limits and severities.
The documented facts were read on 2026-10-01.

## Findings (20)

Findings: what a program can prove. Report only what you measured.

### memory-too-long

- Title: Memory file over the recommended size / Pamäťový súbor nad odporúčanou veľkosťou
- Severity: medium or high, as the measure says
- Suggests: shorten
- Measure: For every memory file (CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, a CLAUDE.md in a subfolder; not an imported file) count its lines. Over 200 lines is a finding: medium, high from twice that. Point at the first line of the largest section and name the three largest sections with their line counts.
- Why: The documentation sets a target of under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file: longer files consume more context and reduce adherence. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### memory-too-large

- Title: Memory file too large to be loaded / Pamäťový súbor je priveľký na načítanie
- Severity: high
- Suggests: shorten
- Measure: A memory file over 4194304 bytes is skipped by Claude Code: high. Such a file is not loaded, so no other check looks at its lines.
- Why: Claude Code skips a CLAUDE.md file over 4 MiB. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### always-loaded-total

- Title: Too much loaded at every session start / Priveľa sa načíta na začiatku každej session
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: make-rule-file
- Measure: Per place (the user files alone, then each project) add up the loaded lines of every file that loads at session start there: memory files, the files they import, rule files without a paths pattern, and AGENTS.md where no memory file stands. Loaded lines leave out block-level HTML comments. Over 400 lines is a finding on the first file of that place, naming the three largest contributors. When the user files alone are over, do not repeat the finding for each project.
- Why: Memory files, the files they import and rule files without a paths pattern load in full at session start and cost context on every request (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md). The documentation gives a target of 200 lines per file and no number for the total, so 400 is a default of this tool; change it with --total-lines.

### duplicate-within

- Title: Instruction repeated in one file / Pokyn zopakovaný v jednom súbore
- Severity: low
- Suggests: delete-duplicate
- Measure: Inside one loaded file, an instruction line that appears again: compare lines after removing the list marker, *, _ and backticks, collapsing spaces, dropping trailing . ; : ! and lowering the case. Only lines of at least 3 words and 12 characters count. The second occurrence is the finding; name the line of the first.
- Why: A repeated line costs context on every request and adds nothing.

### duplicate-across

- Title: Instruction repeated in files that load together / Pokyn zopakovaný v súboroch, ktoré sa načítajú spolu
- Severity: low
- Suggests: delete-duplicate
- Measure: A line of a project file that is equal, compared as in duplicate-within, to a line of a user file that loads in the same place. The project line is the finding; the user line is the original.
- Why: Memory files are additive: every level is in context at the same time, so the second copy is pure cost. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### same-line-in-projects

- Title: Same instruction in several projects / Ten istý pokyn vo viacerých projektoch
- Severity: low
- Suggests: move-to-user
- Measure: A line, compared as in duplicate-within, that stands in the loaded files of two or more projects and in no user file. One finding per line, at its first project, listing the other places.
- Why: The user memory file (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) loads in every project, so an instruction that holds everywhere needs to be written once. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### skill-no-description

- Title: Skill without a description / Skill bez popisu
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A SKILL.md whose front matter has no description, or an empty one.
- Why: Claude uses the description to decide when to apply a skill. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### skill-name-mismatch

- Title: Skill name differs from its folder / Názov skillu sa líši od priečinka
- Severity: low
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A SKILL.md whose front matter name is set and differs from the name of its folder. Point at the name line.
- Why: The name defaults to the directory name; two different names make it unclear which one invokes the skill. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### skill-too-long

- Title: Skill over the recommended length / Skill nad odporúčanou dĺžkou
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: shorten
- Measure: A SKILL.md over 500 lines.
- Why: Skill content stays in context across turns once loaded, so every line is a recurring cost. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### skill-description-too-long

- Title: Skill description over the cap / Popis skillu nad limitom
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A skill whose description and when_to_use together are over 1536 characters. Point at the description line.
- Why: The combined description and when_to_use text is capped at 1536 characters. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### skill-copies-differ

- Title: Copies of one skill that differ / Kópie jedného skillu, ktoré sa líšia
- Severity: low
- Suggests: delete-duplicate
- Measure: A skill of a project with the same folder name as a user skill, where the two SKILL.md files differ (ignore line endings; cmp -s tells, or compare after reading both). Copies that are equal are not a finding.
- Why: The copies started as one text and have drifted apart, so what the skill does depends on where Claude Code is started. This tool does not say which of the two is used.

### skill-unreachable

- Title: Skill that can never be invoked / Skill, ktorý sa nedá vyvolať
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A SKILL.md with both disable-model-invocation: true and user-invocable: false. Point at the disable-model-invocation line.
- Why: disable-model-invocation: true stops Claude from invoking a skill and user-invocable: false stops the user. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### front-matter-unreadable

- Title: Front matter this tool could not read / Hlavička, ktorú tento nástroj nevedel prečítať
- Severity: low
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A skill, command, agent or rule file that opens a front matter block (--- on the first line) that is not readable YAML or never closes. Such a file gets no other front matter check.
- Why: Front matter is YAML between --- markers (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md). This tool reads the common subset; if a full YAML reader also fails, the name and description are lost.

### command-no-description

- Title: Command without a description / Príkaz bez popisu
- Severity: low
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A command file (.claude/commands/**/*.md) without a description in its front matter.
- Why: Commands are skills, and the description is what tells Claude and the user what the command is for. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md

### agent-no-description

- Title: Agent without a description / Agent bez popisu
- Severity: low
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: An agent file (.claude/agents/*.md) without a description in its front matter.
- Why: The description of a subagent says when to hand work to it; without one Claude has nothing to decide by.

### settings-invalid-json

- Title: Settings file that is not valid JSON / Súbor nastavení, ktorý nie je platný JSON
- Severity: high
- Suggests: make-setting
- Measure: A settings.json, settings.local.json or .mcp.json that does not parse as JSON, or whose top level is not an object. Say where the parser stops; never quote the file.
- Why: A settings file that cannot be parsed cannot apply any of its rules or hooks.

### hook-missing-file

- Title: Hook that points at a missing file / Hook, ktorý ukazuje na chýbajúci súbor
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: make-setting
- Measure: A command hook whose script does not exist. The script is the first word of the command, or the word right after an interpreter (bash, sh, zsh, node, python, python3, pwsh, powershell, ruby, deno, bun), when it ends in .sh .bash .zsh .py .js .mjs .cjs .ts .rb .ps1 .cmd .bat .pl .php. ~, $HOME and %USERPROFILE% resolve to the home folder, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the project, a relative path to the project; a relative path in user settings and any other variable cannot be resolved and are skipped, as is a word with a wildcard. One finding per event and script; show the program and the script, never the rest of the command.
- Why: A hook runs on every matching event; one whose script is missing fails every time. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide.md

### hook-unknown-event

- Title: Hook event outside the list this tool knows / Udalosť hooku mimo zoznamu, ktorý tento nástroj pozná
- Severity: low
- Suggests: make-setting
- Measure: A key of "hooks" in settings that is not one of: SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, Notification, MessageDisplay, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, Stop, StopFailure, TeammateIdle, InstructionsLoaded, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, DirectoryAdded, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, PreCompact, PostCompact, PreModelSwitch, PostModelSwitch, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, SessionEnd. Call it outside the list this check knows, never wrong.
- Why: The list is the one of the hooks guide as it was read on 2026-10-01; a newer Claude Code may know more events. Compare the name with the guide before you change anything. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide.md

### import-unresolved

- Title: Import that does not resolve / Import, ktorý nikam nevedie
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: shorten
- Measure: An @path import in a memory file (outside code spans and fenced blocks) that resolves to no file. A relative path resolves against the folder of the file that holds it, ~ to the home folder. A bare @word without a slash or an extension is an import only when that file exists, so it is never a finding.
- Why: A relative import resolves against the file that contains it; an import that resolves to nothing loads nothing. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### import-too-deep

- Title: Import chain deeper than the limit / Reťaz importov hlbšia než limit
- Severity: medium
- Suggests: shorten
- Measure: An import reached at more than 4 hops from a memory file: the import of a memory file is hop 1, an import inside that file hop 2, and so on.
- Why: Imported files can import other files up to a maximum depth of 4 hops; anything deeper is not loaded. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

## Candidates (8)

Candidates: found by wording alone. Each one is read before anything is said about it.

### conflict-candidate

- Title: Pairs of lines that may contradict each other / Dvojice riadkov, ktoré si možno odporujú
- Suggests: review-conflict
- Measure: Two instruction lines that load in the same place, from different sections, where one asks for something (always, must, use, prefer, should; vždy, musí, použi, používaj, preferuj) and the other forbids it (never, do not, must not, avoid; nikdy, nesmie, nepoužívaj, nerob, vyhni sa), with at least two words of 3 letters or more in common. A pair whose two files were already compared in an earlier place is not listed again. Report a pair at its later line and name the other one: a project file comes after a user file, then files go by their path as shown (~/.claude/..., <project>/...), then lines by number. At most 3 pairs per line and 30 per place; count the rest and say how many were left out.
- Why: When instructions conflict, Claude uses judgment to reconcile them; nothing enforces which one wins (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md). This pair was found by shared words alone and may not be a conflict at all.

### exception

- Title: Lines that may be rules with an exception / Riadky, ktoré môžu byť pravidlami s výnimkou
- Suggests: review-exception
- Measure: An instruction line with except, unless, but not, only when, only if (okrem, s výnimkou, pokiaľ nie, iba ak, len ak, iba keď, len keď, výnimka). A line that opens with the marker (- Unless the file is a lockfile.) limits the line before it: report the candidate at that line before, spanning both lines.
- Why: Exceptions pile up and are seldom revisited. One that no longer holds weakens its rule; one that covers most cases has replaced it. The line was found by its words alone: a sentence that describes how something behaves is not a rule.

### procedure-in-memory

- Title: Numbered blocks that may be procedures / Číslované bloky, ktoré môžu byť postupmi
- Suggests: make-skill
- Measure: A block of 4 or more numbered steps (1. or 1) or Step N / Krok N) in a memory file, outside code blocks.
- Why: Multi-step procedures belong in skills, whose content loads only when the skill is invoked (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md). A numbered list is also how rankings, options and principles are written, and a program cannot tell those from steps.

### repeated-request

- Title: Lines that may map a phrase to a fixed action / Riadky, ktoré možno priraďujú k fráze pevnú akciu
- Suggests: make-command
- Measure: A line that maps a phrase to an action: when / whenever / if / every time I say, type, write, ask (keď, ak, kedykoľvek, zakaždým keď, vždy keď ... poviem, napíšem, zadám, pošlem).
- Why: That is what a command is for: custom commands are skills invoked as /name, and their content loads only when used (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md). The line was found by its words alone: one that says how to answer is guidance, not a command.

### automation-in-memory

- Title: Lines that may describe a hook / Riadky, ktoré možno opisujú hook
- Suggests: make-hook
- Measure: A clause that says when (always, after, before, every time, whenever, on save, on commit; vždy, po každ-, pred každ-, pri každ- with any ending (po každej, pred každým), zakaždým, kedykoľvek, po úprave, po zmene, pri uložení) and tells Claude to run a tool as an imperative: run, execute, lint, format, test, typecheck, build (spusti, pusti, naformátuj, zlintuj, otestuj, zostav) with tests, a linter, a formatter, a build or a command as its object. A line that is a repeated-request is not also this.
- Why: An instruction is only read; a hook runs on every matching event without relying on Claude remembering it. This line was found by wording alone: a line that asks for judgement is not hook material. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide.md and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### permission-in-prose

- Title: Lines that may restrict a command in prose only / Riadky, ktoré možno obmedzujú príkaz len slovne
- Suggests: make-setting
- Measure: A line that forbids a command: never / do not / must not run or execute <command>, or use or call a `command in backticks` whose first word is a known command (git, rm, npm, docker, kubectl, terraform, curl and the like); Slovak nespúšťaj, nepúšťaj, nepoužívaj, nevolaj. With without asking / without confirmation (bez opýtania, bez súhlasu) it wants an ask rule, otherwise a deny rule, written Bash(<command> *). Not a candidate when a rule of the settings that apply (user settings everywhere, project settings in that project) already covers the command: Bash, Bash(*) and Bash(<prefix> *) or Bash(<prefix>:*) cover it; for ask, an ask or a deny rule counts. Say only the list and the rule this line wants, never the other rules.
- Why: A restriction in a memory file is a request; a permissions.deny (or ask) rule in settings is enforced whatever Claude decides. The command was read from the words of the line: a line about what tests or scripts must not use is not about what Claude may run. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions.md and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md

### project-specific-in-user

- Title: User-file lines that may be about one project / Riadky používateľského súboru, ktoré sa možno týkajú jedného projektu
- Suggests: move-to-project
- Measure: A line of a user file that names exactly one checked project by its folder name (4 letters or more), or, with two or more projects checked, names a path that exists in exactly one of them, or a stack word that only one project has (npm with package.json, cargo with Cargo.toml, pytest with pyproject.toml, and so on).
- Why: The user memory file loads in every project, so a line about one project costs context everywhere and applies in one place (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md). The line was matched by a word: a common word that is also a folder name, or a tool that only one of the scanned projects has, does not make it about that project.

### skill-no-when-cue

- Title: Skill descriptions that may not say when to use the skill / Popisy skillov, ktoré možno nehovoria, kedy skill použiť
- Suggests: fix-front-matter
- Measure: A skill with a description, no when_to_use and no disable-model-invocation: true, whose description has no "use when / when the user / trigger / should be used / použi / keď" wording.
- Why: Claude uses the description to decide when to apply the skill (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.md). No "use when" wording was found in it, which is a test of words: a description can say when in other words.

## To review (1)

To review: proposes no change.

### mcp-no-permission-rule

- Title: MCP servers without a permission rule / MCP servery bez pravidla povolení
- Measure: A server named in a project .mcp.json (read the server names only) that no permission rule of the user or that project names as mcp__<server> or mcp__<server>__<tool>. The user-level ~/.claude.json is never read.
- Why: A rule such as mcp__<server> in allow, ask or deny says how the tools of a server are treated (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions.md). Only the project file .mcp.json was read (source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.md); servers configured for your user are not known to this tool.
